D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Kim Schrier leads by 22.2 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 61,359 votes; a one point swing is about 1,380 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +13.7 and D +30.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$3.5M cash against $101K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
